lines: Woh jo hum mein tum mein qarar tha
Tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho
couplets.en: There was an understanding between us, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Woh jo hum mein tum mein qarar tha

couplets.en: There was an understanding between us, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Wahi yaani wada, wahi yaani wada nibah ka
Tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho, wahi yaani wada...
couplets.en: That same promise to stay true, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Woh naye gile, woh shikayatein
Woh maze maze ki hikayatein
couplets.en: Those fresh grievances, those complaints, and all those delightful tales.

lines: Woh naye gile, woh shikayatein
Woh maze maze ki hikayatein
couplets.en: Those fresh grievances, those complaints, and all those delightful tales.

lines: Woh har ek baat pe roothna
Tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho
couplets.en: How you would take offense at every little thing, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Woh har ek baat pe roothna
Tumhein yaad ho ke...
couplets.en: How you would take offense at every little thing, whether you remember...

lines: Woh har ek baat pe roothna
Ke na yaad ho, woh jo hum mein tum mein...
couplets.en: How you would take offense at every little thing, and whether you remember what there was between us...

lines: Kabhi hum mein tum mein bhi chah thi
Kabhi hum se tum se bhi rah thi
couplets.en: Once there was affection between us, and once we were close.

lines: Kabhi hum mein tum mein bhi chah thi
Kabhi hum se tum se bhi rah thi
couplets.en: Once there was affection between us, and once we were close.

lines: Kabhi hum bhi tum bhi the ashna
Tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho
couplets.en: We too were once dear to each other, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Kabhi hum bhi tum bhi the ashna

couplets.en: We too were once dear to each other, whether you remember it or not.

lines: Woh jo hum mein tum mein...
couplets.en: What there once was between us...

lines: Jise aap ginte the ashna
Jise aap kehte the ba-wafa
couplets.en: The one you counted a friend, the one you called faithful.

lines: Jise aap ginte the ashna

lines: Main wahi hoon Momin-e-mubtala
Tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho
couplets.en: I am that same lovesick Momin, whether you remember me or not.
